description: 1 double bedroom, 1 shower bathroom, open plan living-kitchen-dining, 1 storage room. Double-aspect apartment — windows on left and bottom facade(s). Kitchen is on an interior wall away from windows — less natural light at the cooking position. 1 double bedroom (no walk-in wardrobe, no en-suite), 0 single bedroom(s). Single bedrooms can each function as bedroom, home office, hobby room or guest room. Kitchen: galley, no island. Cook faces the wall, back to the living and dining area. No wall separates kitchen from dining and living — fully open plan. Living area arrangement: linear kitchen-dining-living. Dining table visible, approximately 2 seats. Bathroom config: 1 shower-only bathroom(s). Single bathroom — sequential morning routine. Largest bedroom at far end of apartment from living area — maximum privacy and acoustic separation from household activity. Path to kitchen passes through full corridor length. Storage room in entry or private zone, not adjacent to kitchen — suitable for coats, shoes, bikes, laundry or utility storage, not as kitchen pantry. Entry area has space for coat and shoe storage. From entry: kitchen is long corridor, living area is long corridor. No door between entry and living/kitchen — relevant where local regulations require separation. Suits: singles or couples.
not_suitable_for: jurisdictions requiring door separation between entry and kitchen
